prompts.name: atlas-good
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production 3x3 transparent sprite ATLAS for a Middle-earth tactical pixel game, not a poster. Nine isolated environment objects, each centered in its own equally spaced square cell with generous transparent gutters, all 9 fully visible, no contact between cells, no labels, no text, no terrain bases or rectangular ground patches. Strict high-angle front view looking down 40 degrees, front roof and roof top surfaces visible, NOT isometric side view, coherent finely crafted 16-bit pixel art, clean intentional pixel clusters, crisp edges, muted natural colors, detailed weathered materials, light from upper left, transparent background. Objects should embody actual Lord of the Rings film architecture, not generic fantasy. Left-to-right top-to-bottom EXACT subjects: (1) Minas Tirith white limestone gatehouse segment with distinctive Gondorian high pointed arch and restrained winged crown carvings, no modern roofs; (2) Osgiliath ruined pale stone domed riverside building with broken archways, no intact walls underneath; (3) Amon Sul Weathertop circular broken Arnorian watchtower ring, visible inner worn stairs and fallen crown stones; (4) Helm's Deep Hornburg round squat gray stone bastion with curved sloping buttresses, no thatch; (5) Edoras Meduseld Golden Hall, broad long low timber structure with golden thatched roof, horse-head ridge finials and dark green banners; (6) Pelennor humble Gondorian farmhouse and small grain store forming one building cluster, cream stone walls weathered terracotta roofs; (7) Minas Tirith Court iconic WHITE TREE, elegant bare white trunk with sparse tiny blossoms, growing from natural roots and small pale stone circular tree well, no huge podium; (8) Dale distinct northern lake-town merchant gabled timber-and-stone dwelling, dark red tiled roofs, blue painted shutters, dragon-fire weathering; (9) Hornburg interior stone gate and timber-roofed defense gallery, unmistakable Rohan carved horse heads but primarily rugged limestone fortress. Clear silhouettes, each object has unique footprint, human doors 1/5 building height, grounded believable architecture, no characters, no UI, no letters, no soft illustration, no smeary rendering, no chunky low-resolution placeholders.

prompts.name: atlas-nature
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE production environment SPRITE ATLAS, 3 columns x 3 rows, nine fully isolated objects on genuine transparent background, equal grid cells with generous empty gutters, no labels. Middle-earth LORD OF THE RINGS film-world specificity. Detailed crisp 16-bit pixel art with intentional pixel clusters, weathered realistic material shapes rendered as tactical sprites, high-angle FRONT view looking down 40 degrees with top planes visible, not side view, not 3D render, light upper left, same scale and pixel density across all nine. EXACT subjects left-to-right top-to-bottom: 1 FANGORN ancient massive gnarled oak, twisted buttress roots, moss-draped dark emerald wide canopy, enormous old trunk, not a humanoid Ent; 2 RIVENDELL slender Elven open pavilion with pale stone flowing arches, red-brown elegant tiled multi-tier roof and climbing ivy, airy Tolkien architecture; 3 LOTHLORIEN huge silver-white mallorn tree with luminous warm golden leaves and delicate small wooden flet spiral platform in branches; 4 MORIA monumental square dwarven pillar, broad angular carved geometric capital and faceted granite base, dark bluish black stone, no moss, no grass, no daylight; 5 DUNHARROW pair of ancient tall standing stones carved with faint spectral marks on rocky footholds, gray mountain stone, no temple; 6 EREBOR monumental dwarven mountain gate facade, angular straight geometric stonework, embedded gold inlay restrained, door dark open empty, broad descending steps, no round arches; 7 MIRKWOOD oppressive giant twisted black-barked tree with dark purple green dense canopy, cobwebs between thick roots, no golden foliage; 8 GONDOLIN noble white Elven gate tower cluster, elegantly soaring silver-white buttresses and thin blue banners, fine leaf carved arches, neither Gondorian nor Disney; 9 EREBOR ROYAL HALL broad faceted dwarven column with deep green marble shaft, gold geometric bands and large dark angular capital, distinctly more ornate than cell4. All 9 silhouettes whole and separated, rooted feet contact visible, no rectangular ground chunks, no circular game bases, no characters, no UI, no text, no painterly blur, no glowing neon, no generic medieval castles.

prompts.name: atlas-dark
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type ONE production Middle-earth dark-land ENVIRONMENT ATLAS, 3x3 equally spaced grid, nine completely isolated whole sprites on TRUE transparent background, broad transparent margins each cell, no shared terrain strips, no labels. Exact Lord of the Rings Middle-earth aesthetic, grim practical monumental architecture, NOT generic cartoon evil fantasy. High-angle FRONT view looking downward 40 degrees, roof/tops visible, finely crafted crisp 16-bit pixel art, clean pixel clusters, same tactical-game scale across all cells, upper-left muted lighting. EXACT subjects reading left-to-right top-to-bottom: 1 ISENGARD excavation furnace group, squat dark iron foundry with brick chimney and timber gantry, tiny restrained hot orange furnace opening; 2 BLACK GATE of Mordor heavy broad battlement section with serrated iron crown, monumental paired sloping black buttresses and narrow recessed iron door, NOT a spiky tower; 3 GORGOROTH jagged massive black volcanic basalt outcrop with dry gray ash-coated cracks, tiny dull red ember seams, no huge lava pool; 4 DEAD MARSHES reedbed and sunken ancient stone tomb fragment, sodden ochre reeds, a weathered broken soldier shield and gray-green mud roots, no human figures, no bright magic; 5 DOL GULDUR broken angular black-green fortress stair tower, rotting masonry and creeping dead vines, narrow empty slit windows; 6 ANGBAND brutal primitive ironbound stone blast-gate bastion, immense low black metal doorway built into scorched jagged volcanic rock, ancient war-fortress not Sauron tower; 7 ORTHANC recognizable smooth black four-horned tower base and tapered blade pillars, sharply cut polished obsidian, a tall silhouette with tower top four prongs fully visible; 8 BARAD DUR recognizable massively buttressed black Sauron fortress tower, broad descending defensive tiers, tiny restrained fiery eye at top, tower fully in frame, distinct crenellated Mordorian silhouette not Orthanc; 9 MINAS MORGUL pale corpse-green luminous ruined Gondorian gate tower, blade-like parapets, black-violet weathering, ominous but restrained sickly internal light, no neon bloom. Each sprite independent distinct silhouette, no generic repeated cottage or castle, no rectangular terrain base, no ground tiles, no game token disks, no characters, no text, no UI, no painterly blur, no thick outlines, no magenta.
